anomalies.observed: On the DISPLAY sub-sheet (display.kicad_sch), the SSD1306 interface-select pin BS0 (pin 10) is wired to the VCC rail and BS1 (pin 11) is wired to GND, giving a BS2,BS1,BS0 strap of 1,0,x rather than 0,1,0.
anomalies.expected: The specification states the I2C-mode strap must be BS0→GND, BS1→VCC, BS2→GND (BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0), which is what makes D0=DISP_SCL and D1/D2=DISP_SDA behave as an I2C slave.

evidence.quote: display.kicad_sch (DISPLAY sheet): pin 10 'BS0' horizontal wire joins the vertical VCC rail (VCC arrow at top right); pin 11 'BS1' wire joins the GND arrow below it.
BS0 (pin 10) → GND; BS1 (pin 11) → VCC; BS2 (pin 12) → GND ... BS2,BS1,BS0 = 0,1,0 strapping ... is the SSD1306's documented I2C-mode pin configuration

anomalies.impact: The SSD1306 is strapped out of I2C mode (into an SPI/parallel interface). The DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA nets driven by PB13/PB14 on D0/D1/D2 no longer correspond to SCL/SDA, so the OLED will not communicate and the display subsystem is non-functional.

parsed.summary: Most of the schematic matches the spec functionally (NFC I2C pull-ups, TSC sampling cap/series R, charge-pump caps, IREF, NRST pull-up, BOOT0=0), but the SSD1306 BS0/BS1 interface straps appear tied to VCC/GND respectively — the opposite of the spec's 0,1,0 I2C configuration — which would put the display in a non-I2C mode and break the DISP_SCL/DISP_SDA bus.
